message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common “tools” (websites, apps, APIs, and platforms) you can use to book flights, from consumer‑facing sites to developer‑ready APIs:

| Category | Tool / Service | What it’s good for | Typical Use‑Case |
|----------|----------------|--------------------|------------------|
| **Consumer‑facing flight search & booking** | **Google Flights** | Fast, clean UI, price alerts, multi‑city itineraries | Quick comparison & booking directly with airlines |
| | **Skyscanner** | Aggregates many airlines & OTAs, flexible dates | Great for “best‑price” searches, multi‑stop options |
| | **Kayak** | Price alerts, “price forecast” feature | Good for monitoring fare trends |
| | **Momondo** | Very wide coverage, often finds cheaper fares | Useful for budget travelers |
| | **Expedia / Hotels.com** | Bundles flights + hotels + car rentals | One‑stop shop for vacation planning |
| | **Priceline / Hotwire** | “Name Your Own Price” & “Express Deals” | Last‑minute deals & hidden‑city booking |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, mobile‑first | Ideal for planning ahead & getting alerts |
| | **Airline direct sites** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa) | Lowest fare guarantee, loyalty perks | Best for frequent flyers & loyalty points |
| | **Travel agencies / OTAs** (e.g., Travelzoo, Orbitz) | Often have exclusive promo codes | Good for bundled packages |
| | **Mobile apps** (e.g., Hopper, Skyscanner, Google Flights) | On‑the‑go booking & notifications | Handy for travelers who prefer phones |
| **Developer‑ready APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, availability, pricing | Enterprise travel apps, custom booking engines |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Comprehensive flight data, booking, inventory | Large‑scale travel tech solutions |
| | **Travelport (Galileo, Apollo)** | Global distribution system (GDS) access | Airline & OTA integration |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search & price comparison | Build your own flight search widget |
| | **Google Flights API (via Google Travel)** | Flight search & pricing | Integrate Google’s flight data into apps |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, tracking | Add flight status to booking confirmations |
| | **OpenSky Network API** | Real‑time flight data (open source) | For aviation enthusiasts & data projects |
| | **FlightStats API** | Historical & real‑time flight data | Useful for analytics & predictive modeling |
| | **AirLabs API** | Flight search, pricing, and airline data | Small‑to‑medium business travel tools |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate flight booking & revenue sharing | Monetize flight search on blogs or sites |
| **Other useful tools** | **TripIt** | Organize itineraries, auto‑import from email | Post‑booking itinerary management |
| | **Google Trips / Apple Travel** | Offline maps & itinerary sync | Travel companion for offline use |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Live flight tracking | Check flight status before departure |
| | **FlightAware Flight Tracking** | Real‑time flight status & alerts | Monitor delays or gate changes |

### How to choose

| Need | Recommended Tool(s) |
|------|---------------------|
| **Quick personal booking** | Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak |
| **Bundle flights + hotels** | Expedia, Priceline, Hotwire |
| **Last‑minute deals** | Hopper, Priceline Express Deals |
| **Frequent flyer loyalty** | Airline direct sites (use their loyalty program) |
| **Build a custom booking app** | Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, Skyscanner API |
| **Add flight status to your app** | FlightAware, FlightStats |
| **Monetize flight search** | Travelpayouts, Skyscanner Affiliate |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper details on any specific platform, or if you’re looking for a particular type of booking experience (e.g., budget, luxury, business class, multi‑city itineraries).
